title: E. S. Richardson Elementary School enrolls 278 students, 4 more than previous school year
text:
E. S. Richardson Elementary School enrolls 278 students, 4 more than previous school year
E. S. Richardson Elementary School had 278 students enrolled in the 2025-26 school year, according to the Louisiana Department of Education.
That was a 1.5% increase from the previous school year, when the school enrolled 274 students.
Of the students enrolled in the 2025-26 school year, 52.9% were boys and 47.1% were girls.
Most students were Black, representing 67.6% of E. S. Richardson Elementary School's total enrollment.
The school is in the Webster Parish School District, whose central office is in Minden.
Statewide, there were 660,349 students enrolled in Louisiana in the 2025-26 school year.
Louisiana ranked near the bottom nationally for public school systems, according to WalletHub's 2026 analysis. The analysis placed the state 44th among the 50 states and Washington, D.C., with a quality rank of 42 and a safety rank of 48. WalletHub compared states across 32 metrics, including measures tied to student performance, funding, school safety, class size and instructor credentials.
In 2025, Black and White students were the two largest groups reported in Louisiana public schools, according to KIDS COUNT data from Agenda for Children based on Louisiana Department of Education enrollment figures. Black students made up 41.8% of public school enrollment, while White students accounted for 40.2%. Hispanic students accounted for 11.6% of enrollment, continuing a long-term increase in the state's public schools.
Information in this article was obtained from the Kentucky Department of Education. The source data can be found here.
